title: Critical Minerals Discovery-to-Finance Convergence
claims_boundary: This record describes an opportunity/partner strategy only. Worldshepherd does not currently claim DP2 airborne subsurface radar feasibility, flight heritage, kW-class RF hardware, mineral-discovery performance, federal financing approval, or project-developer readiness.

primary_routes.title: Novel Radio Frequency Sensing Technologies
primary_routes.technical_objective: High-altitude high-speed airborne 3D subsurface tomography for metals and critical minerals.
primary_routes.hard_gate: Direct-to-Phase-II only; modeling/simulation alone is insufficient. Proposer must already have physical airborne subsurface-radar or similar validation with empirical flight data, receiver characterization, and scaling models.
worldshepherd_exclusions: do not claim radar hardware maturity

primary_routes.issuer: U.S. Department of Energy with 14 federal partners
primary_routes.title: Common Investment Initial Screening Application
primary_routes.technical_objective: Route eligible energy infrastructure and critical-mineral/material projects to federal funding, loan, loan-guarantee, or investment channels.
primary_routes.hard_gate: Requires a credible eligible physical project/project developer and financing-ready evidence. Submission does not create any government commitment.

convergence_concept.name: Worldshepherd Critical Minerals Discovery-to-Qualification Fabric
sequence: qualified airborne/geophysical sensing partner generates validated survey data
ECHO records data provenance, configuration, uncertainty, and evidence lineage
SARA orchestrates analysis and decision workflows
PRIME enforces human authorization and claims boundaries
PRE maps identified resource/project needs to recurring federal requirements
SUPPLY_CHAIN_ILLUMINATION links prospective resource to processing/manufacturing dependencies
partner project developer pursues applicable federal financing/industrialization channel

mandatory_next_actions: identify at least five DP2-qualified airborne subsurface-radar/geophysical sensing partner candidates with empirical flight data evidence
identify at least five mining/mineral-processing/project-development partners able to use the DOE multi-agency intake
prepare partner-facing software/evidence architecture that contains no controlled or proprietary partner data
perform ITAR/EAR and data-handling review before any DARPA technical exchange
keep all non-public controlled technical data outside the public Sara_pro repository
